rows.note: Operational notation for latest-as-of query only, with no exact tslot. TxAsOf resolves transaction-time versions per (cell,band,tslot), bounded by τ; then latest valid slot ≤ t* selected with lexicographic CID tie-break. This is not a formula for every endpoint/mode.

print: An agent passes a reference to a specific physical observation; the receiver resolves it and checks the evidence.
Built with standard BLAKE3, Ed25519, CBOR and Merkle logs. STAC, openEO, PROV, C2PA, RAG and temporal storage provide complementary layers.
rows.note: Invention taxonomy: contribution = physical-observation evidence handoff with receiver checks; standard enablers = BLAKE3, Ed25519, canonical CBOR, Merkle logs and content addressing; complementary = RAG, STAC, openEO, PROV, C2PA, generic provenance, temporal databases/event sourcing, generic agent memory and EO-agent orchestration. No priority/first-in-world claim.
